title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
description:

Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Â

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

We are seeking an experienced Account Director to drive revenue growth and expand strategic customer relationships across the UK, Ireland, and selected major European accounts. In this senior commercial role, you will lead sales strategy and business development for a portfolio of mobile network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions. You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Working closely with technical, marketing, product, and sales teams, you will develop compelling value propositions and deliver solutions that address complex customer challenges. You will engage with mobile network operators, service providers, infrastructure companies, and other key industry stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the evolution of next-generation networks, including 5G, IoT, and emerging connectivity technologies, within a collaborative and globally distributed environment.

Develop and leverage strategic partnerships and channel relationships to strengthen market coverage and create additional routes to market. Collaborate with Solution Engineering teams on technical qualification, product demonstrations, customer evaluations, and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives. Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts. Apply disciplined sales methodologies and opportunity qualification processes to ensure predictable growth and consistent commercial performance. Experience gained within telecom software providers, network equipment manufacturers, test and measurement companies, engineering consultancies, service organisations, or technology suppliers serving mobile network operators is particularly relevant. A proactive, results-oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset, with strong relationship-building skills and the ability to identify and pursue new commercial opportunities.

title: Knowledge Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States.

In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Consolidate and organize knowledge from multiple platforms, including Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, HubSpot, Zendesk, Highspot, and Slack, ensuring that each source has clear ownership and scheduled review dates. Collaborate with Data and Business Insights teams to make existing business data AI-ready by providing curated, read-only Snowflake views and standardized metric definitions that align with established reporting systems. Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows for business functions such as customer support ticket triage, renewal research, accounts payable processing, and software reviews. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Create automated pipelines that identify changes in documentation, business systems, and operational processes, ensuring that knowledge repositories, AI agents, and workflows remain accurate and up to date. Structure and optimize information for AI retrieval through taxonomy development, metadata management, content chunking, tagging, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Establish evaluation frameworks and quality assurance processes to measure AI agent accuracy, detect outdated or conflicting information, and minimize hallucinations before and after deployment. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Document technical architecture, workflows, integration standards, and operational processes while staying informed about emerging AI technologies and industry best practices. Monitor AI usage, operational costs, adoption, and feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve answer quality, and prioritize future enhancements. Partner with subject-matter experts across Support, Customer Success, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Product, and Engineering to capture institutional knowledge, map business processes, and establish content ownership. Collaborate with training teams, Product Marketing, and departmental AI champions to transform product documentation, customer support resources, and training materials into AI-accessible knowledge for internal teams and external customers. Integrate AI-powered tools into employee and customer training programs to improve knowledge sharing, self-service capabilities, and operational efficiency.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 5 years of experience in knowledge engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or technical knowledge management. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.

Full-time remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to a company-wide AI transformation and help establish the foundations of an AI-first operating model. High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Opportunity to develop and implement innovative solutions that improve employee productivity and customer experiences. Significant ownership and influence over AI architecture, knowledge management standards, and automation strategy. Professional development opportunities through continuous exposure to emerging AI tools, technologies, and practices.

title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI & Science Platform
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding.

The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Redditâs analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. We are looking for software engineers who enjoy building AI systems that people can depend on: useful workflows, clear interfaces, thoughtful evals, and software that improves through production experience.

In this role, you will own a substantial part of our agent and scientific-tooling platform. You will design and ship capabilities, maintain and improve existing systems, and work with applied scientists and data scientists to make advanced analysis accessible. You will remain close to the code and to the people using it, from an initial prototype through rollout, operation, and ongoing refinement.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve the software that powers our analytics agent and shared analytical workflows, including backend services, reusable libraries, APIs, and integrations with data and scientific tools.
  • Design reliable agent workflows: context retrieval, planning and orchestration, structured tool calls, execution state, result validation, and clear handling of incomplete or failed tasks.
  • Develop evaluation infrastructure and use it continuously. Maintain versioned task sets, automated checks, human-reviewed examples, regression reports, and release gates that expose meaningful failures.
  • Improve agent quality through careful failure analysis and measured changes to prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflow design, balancing correctness, latency, and cost.
  • Operate production systems with actionable observability, incident response, dependency upgrades, backward-compatible interfaces, staged releases, and rollback paths.
  • Build secure analytical execution and data integrations with appropriate access controls, execution limits, audit trails, provenance, and reproducible artifacts.
  • Partner with scientists to turn validated methods into supported capabilities, preserving input requirements, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations through the API and agent experience.
  • Lead technical design and delivery within your area, coordinate with partner teams, review code and designs, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and maintains software.
  • Work directly with users to prioritize recurring needs, support adoption and migrations, and measure whether the platform helps people complete analytical work successfully.

Required qualifications

  • Substantial professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production services, platforms, or developer tools from design through deployment and ongoing operation. Five or more years is a useful sourcing guideline.
  • Strong programming ability, including production Python, and sound engineering fundamentals in API design, data modeling, automated testing, code review, distributed systems, and debugging.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying tool-using agents or multi-step LLM applications, with concrete understanding of context, structured outputs, orchestration, state, and model failure modes.
  • Experience designing and using evals to improve AI systems: representative cases, baselines, failure analysis, grader limitations, and quality criteria that influence what ships.
  • Practical experience with service reliability, authorization, queues or asynchronous execution, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and operational monitoring.
  • Working fluency in SQL and experience integrating data-intensive services or analytical tools; an ability to preserve data provenance and documented analytical constraints.
  • A record of leading substantial technical work with other engineers and partner teams, explaining tradeoffs clearly, and helping others contribute effectively.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with analytics agents, text-to-SQL, data discovery, notebook or code-execution environments, or internal platforms for data scientists.
  • Experience with agent evaluation harnesses, tool protocols such as MCP, model gateways, retrieval systems, or secure sandboxed execution.
  • Experience building reusable scientific libraries, packaging statistical methods behind stable APIs, or collaborating closely with scientists on validation.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and large-scale analytical data systems such as BigQuery, Trino, Spark, or Airflow.
  • Experience building product interfaces in TypeScript or React, or improving developer experience and adoption for a shared platform.

This is a hands-on software engineering role. We value the ability to learn the analytical domain and work well with scientific experts; a research degree, publication record, and novel-method research are not required.

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Store Operations

title: Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

  • Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

  • Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik.

Was dich erwartet

  • Wirksamkeit: Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem zentralen Neuentwicklungsprojekt, in der du Planung, Arbeitsweise und Verlässlichkeit unserer Softwareentwicklung maßgeblich prägst.

  • Interdisziplinäres Team: Zusammenarbeit mit Fachleuten aus Physik, Ingenieurwesen und Softwareentwicklung – mit kurzen Wegen und offener Kommunikation.

  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Eine zertifizierte Technologie mit direktem Beitrag zu Anlagensicherheit und Klimaschutz.

title: Senior Project & Process Manager – HR Operations (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. This is a senior role for someone who takes on our tougher operational problems and drives them forward together with the teams involved. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale.

Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Process Landscape Management & Optimization: Analyze, document, and continuously advance our People Operations process landscape across Europe. Map existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design lean, standardized, and scalable processes with global applicability in mind, keeping documentation and standards up to date as the organization evolves. Working with the Digital Transformation and Tech teams, you translate operational pain points into clear requirements, and drive automation where it creates real value on the ground
  • End-to-End Project Leadership & Change Management: Own complex, cross-functional HR initiatives end to end, including policy rollouts, compliance frameworks, operational restructuring, and transformation projects. You (co)-lead these independently from scoping through execution to handover, set the pace and the milestones, manage stakeholders and dependencies across markets, create operational playbooks, and ensure teams transition smoothly to new ways of working
  • Central Ops Counterpart: You are the central point of contact and the representative for People Operations in cross-functional projects, most importantly with our People Partners and the Digital Transformation team, and additionally with our Centers of Excellence and other stakeholders such as Finance. You make sure People Operations has a clear, informed voice in these initiatives across Europe and at global level, and you bring the operational perspective consistently into every cross-functional conversation
  • Day-to-Day Enablement: You actively support local European People Ops Managers by delivering tangible process improvements that make their daily work faster, safer, and easier

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations, HR Project Management, within a fast-paced, international organization or matrix environment
  • Process Expertise: Deep, hands-on track record of designing, mapping, and implementing complex HR processes, and of being the go-to person others rely on when a process spans multiple teams, departments, and markets
  • Project Management: You (co)-lead cross-functional projects end to end and independently, manage diverse stakeholders and dependencies, and keep scope, timelines, and budgets in check without close supervision
  • Tech-Savvy & AI Mindset: You have a solid understanding of modern HRIS and HR Service Delivery tools. You make decisions based on data and are genuinely curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations. You do not need to be an expert today, but the interest and openness need to be there. We invest in building these capabilities together
  • Communicator: You can align different departments, push back constructively when needed, and simplify complex operational topics for any audience. Fluent in English; additional European languages, especially German, are a strong plus
  • Mindset: You push boundaries to challenge the status quo, and you build for generations by creating robust, audit-proof frameworks rather than quick fixes

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Client Success Senior Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich!

You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.
  • Ensure trusting, high-value partnerships with HR contacts, Procurement counterparts, and C-level executives by articulating Wellhub's mission to enhance employee health, engagement, and happiness.
  • Drive the commercial agenda across your account portfolio, leading annual contract renewals, expansions, and renegotiations to deliver continuous value.
  • Lead client launches, ongoing strategic relaunch initiatives, and awareness events in close partnership with the Wellhub Wellbeing Engagement Team for end-to-end execution.
  • Present and implement best-practice workflows, evaluate member growth metrics, suggest targeted adoption strategies, and provide continuous platform updates.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Customer Experience, Operations, User Growth Marketing, Fitness Partnerships, Business Development, and Wellbeing Engagement teams—to build adoption strategies and hit shared goals.
  • Analyze client data and metrics to deliver actionable findings, shaping tailored communication and awareness campaigns that boost user engagement and defeat inactivity.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.


WHO YOU ARE

  • An accomplished relationship leader with 5+ years of experience managing complex client relationships in a client-facing capacity.
  • A commercial driver with proven expertise leading end-to-end contract negotiations for renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, aligning client growth goals with company revenue targets.
  • A dynamic and collaborative partner who thrives in team environments, brings creative problem-solving skills, and works seamlessly with cross-functional groups.
  • An exceptional communicator who provides superior customer service to both internal stakeholders and executive-level external clients.
  • A detail-oriented project manager with deep experience orchestrating multiple complex client deliverables and priorities concurrently.
  • An analytical thinker fluent in tracking data, interpreting performance reports, and leveraging insights into concrete operational strategies.
  • A process innovator capable of refining job protocols, optimizing workflows, and proactively navigating change in a fast-paced global business environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in enterprise client relationship management and commercial contract negotiations are mandatory requirements.


WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

description:

Als Onboarding Manager:in - Trainer:in für digitale Pflegedokumentation sorgst du dafür, dass Pflegekräfte unseren KI-Begleiter sicher im Alltag nutzen. Du schulst Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften direkt bei unseren Kund:innen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode und bringst deine Pflegeerfahrung ein, damit aus Dokumentationszeit wieder Zeit für Zuwendung wird.

  • Pflegeausbildung oder praktische Erfahrung in der Pflege (stationäre Langzeitpflege, Krankenhaus oder ambulant) - du kennst Pflegedokumentation und Alltagsroutinen aus eigener Erfahrung.

title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV).

  • Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths.

  • Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality in this area.

  • Projects: You lead complex, cross-functional safety projects, such as new labs and build-outs, and coordinate contractor safety.

  • Incidents & Root Cause Analysis: You investigate incidents and near-misses, run root cause analyses and follow every corrective action through to closure.

  • Training & Mentoring: You build the training and instruction programme, document knowledge, give internal talks and mentor colleagues and the safety contacts in the teams.

  • ESG: Support the team with knowledge, advice and guidance on environmental and sustainability topics, and help develop how ESG fits into Orbem as the topic grows.

  • Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters.

Your responsibilities include:

Keeping Orbem compliant with German occupational health and safety law, from risk assessments and training to incident follow-up and contact with authorities. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem.

Your Experience and Skills

  • You hold the Sifa qualification under § 7 ASiG, on top of a degree in engineering, safety engineering or natural sciences, occupational health & safety or a related discipline.

  • 6+ years of experience in occupational health and safety, with proven depth

  • Strong knowledge of German regulations (ArbSchG, ArbStättV, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, BioStoffV,).

  • You have worked in laboratory or high-tech environments. If MRI and magnetic field safety is new to you, we will help you build that side.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional safety projects and of setting standards and building systems, not only applying them.

  • You drive corrective actions to closure and win buy-in, not just the technical argument.

  • You have the standing to give independent advice and hold your position with management, engineers, and scientists, while staying pragmatic.

  • You share what you know: you document, train and mentor instead of becoming a single point of failure.

  • Although you work locally, you think across locations and see exchanges with colleagues at other sites as an opportunity to grow, both virtually and through occasional business trips.

  • Excellent communication in German (C1+) & English (B2+).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Knowledge of electrical safety (VDE standards, DGUV Vorschrift 3)

  • Strong knowledge of StrlSchG

  • Experience with facilities in a deep-tech or high-tech environment.

  • Skilled at interpreting and adapting regulatory frameworks to ensure compliance in new geographical regions,

  • Experience with ESG topics such as sustainability reporting or a carbon footprint.

  • Knowledge of US requirements (OSHA)

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

title: Finance Manager (Finance, Data & Automation) (gn) @ Atlantic, Berlin
description:
About Atlantic

Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring.

As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo.

For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown.

The role

As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on.

Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions.

Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings.

Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks.

Special projects. You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management.

The mission

Fast-forward - here's what you've built:

  • Half the manual work is gone. Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them

  • The portfolio talks back. AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks

  • Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system. One trusted source the whole team relies on

The moonshot: Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it.

About you

You'll feel at home here if you:

  • Learned finance where the bar is high. Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team. 

  • Know your accounting inside out, and enjoy putting it to work on a fund

  • Think AI-first. Claude is already part of your workday, and anything you do twice, you want to automate

  • Love turning data into insight, not just reconciling it

  • Own your numbers. You work independently, follow through, and double-check because you care

  • Roll up your sleeves. You're as happy running payments today as building the automation that runs them tomorrow

  • Are curious about startups, deep tech and the founders building them

  • Speak fluent German and English

Bonus points if you've worked in or around venture capital, or built your own dashboards, BI reports or no-code automations.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence | Working Student (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As an Entrepreneur in Residence Working Student at CONROO, you will turn ideas into business opportunities and help shape the future of our company. Working closely with our founding team and Sales team, you will explore untapped markets, build new business areas from the ground up, and translate strategic ideas into actionable solutions.

🎖️What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You will collaborate closely with the founding team to explore new business opportunities and strategic initiatives.

  • You will conduct in-depth analyses and prepare decision-making frameworks for the founding team.

By 3 months

  • You will identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities and untapped market potential.

  • You will develop innovative strategies and actionable proposals to improve our operations and expand our market presence.

  • You will oversee and optimize the execution of marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure alignment with business goals.

By 6 months

  • You will collaborate with the founding team to develop and launch new business areas from the ground up.

  • You will support cross-departmental initiatives that contribute to the company's growth.

  • You will continuously explore emerging trends and technologies to keep our offerings at the forefront of the logistics and IT sectors.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Information Technology, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or a related field

  • You have relevant professional experience in entrepreneurship, business development, strategy, or project management.

  • You have excellent written and spoken skills in English.

  • You have strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

  • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • You take ownership of your work, and are motivated to take on responsibility and make a meaningful impact.

  • You continuously look for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • You bring a hands-on mindset, with a 'never-stop-learning' attitude and a desire to grow alongside the team

  • You take accountability for your tasks, follow through on commitments, and proactively address challenges.

This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 2-3 days per week on site.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45 minute interview with the CEO & hiring manager, Felix.

  4. Complete a take-home case study.

  5. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia.

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements.

Who we are. Zeitgeist Labs is the applied research institute of the future in Berlin. Founded by scientists from Stanford, MIT, Max Planck and Charité with experience at McKinsey and in previous startups. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage company at its inflection point.

Problem we solve. Governments, foundations, NGOs and universities spend trillions every year on programs meant to improve people's lives. The industry that measures whether any of it works is slow and manual: months of fieldwork, hand-coded interviews, a 300 page report that lands 2 years after the program ends. The physical sciences are being accelerated by AI co-scientists. The social sciences are not, yet. In an age of ever-increasing complexity, we are building the tools that allow researchers to tackle the hardest scientific questions of our time: how societies work, and what actually changes them.

In short. You own problems end to end, working directly with the founders. Understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

What you'll do.

  • You work directly with the founders on the system our clients use every day. You own problems end to end: understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

  • Build the architecture that turns thousands of data points, interviews, surveys and papers into insights

  • Run evals when a model or prompt changes and help decide what ships

How we work.

We are a human-in-the-loop AI company. Everyone here runs a fleet of agents; the human sets the direction, makes the calls and verifies the result. Why Zeitgeist Labs.

  • Daily work with the founders, hybrid in Berlin

You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products.

Brief Translation & Creative Briefing

Insight & Creative Springboards

Client & Team Collaboration

• Be collaborative and generous with your thinking across OLIVER and client teams 
• Contribute to pitches, organic growth, case studies and thought leadership 

 

What you need to be great in this role: 

• An exceptionally strong, hands-on strategist who loves doing the work, not just directing it 
• A natural brief writer – you get to the single-minded thought quickly and write briefs creatives want to answer 
• Insight-driven, with a nose for the audience truths and cultural tensions that make work feel fresh 
• A lover of creative work, with the taste and confidence to judge it and help make it better 
• Really into powerful performance comms, wherever it sits in the funnel – but not limited to it 
• AI-fluent and curious, with real examples of using AI to find better insights and new perspectives, not just to work faster

• Consistently stronger creative work across the bank's brands 
• Measurable performance and effectiveness results across the funnel 
• AI demonstrably improving the quality of insight and creative springboards 
• Trusted by clients and valued by creative teams as a generous, constructive partner

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Grocery & Retail, UK and Ireland
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role

Deliveroo is seeking a commercially driven, strategic and execution-focused Head of New Verticals Marketing to lead the next phase of growth across our grocery and retail businesses in the UK & Ireland. On-demand grocery and retail are among the most exciting parts of our business: customers increasingly want their weekly shop, everyday essentials and gifts delivered quickly, and we help the top grocers and retailers grow to meet these needs. 

You will shape and deliver the UK & Ireland marketing strategy across grocery and retail, managing the marketing budget and driving category positioning, partner growth and campaign excellence, and lead a team to bring it to life. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Commercial, Growth, Product and Analytics, you will act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and some of the biggest brands in the UK & Ireland, driving measurable commercial impact. 

This is a chance to make your mark with real influence over strategy, partners and investment.

What you'll be doing

Strategy, planning and performance

  • Shape and lead the grocery and retail marketing strategy for the UK & Ireland, tied to ambitious growth targets and informed by what customers, categories and performance are telling us.
  • Build annual and quarterly plans around the missions and moments that matter to UK & Ireland shoppers, from the weekly shop to key seasonal and trading events.
  • Balance brand building and performance marketing to drive sustainable acquisition, retention and frequency, with disciplined, ROI-led investment.
  • Own the growth targets and KPIs for grocery and retail, monitor performance and course-correct quickly. Set the measurement framework, lead post-campaign analysis and turn learnings into sharper plans, presenting results to leadership.
  • Bring Commercial, Product, Growth and Analytics together to solve cross-functional problems and give structure to new, fast-moving areas.

Category and propositions

  • Develop a distinctive, data-led category strategy for grocery and retail, with clear positioning and value propositions that stand out for customers and partners.
  • Turn market trends and shopper behaviour into scalable growth plans for partners. 
  • Share what works in the UK & Ireland with other markets and tailor global strategy to local needs.

Partners and growth

  • Build strong marketing partnerships with leading grocers and retailers, from joint business plans to integrated campaigns, helping them grow on Deliveroo and shaping propositions customers love.
  • Own the working partnership with Commercial leadership, supporting the winning and launch of new partners. 
  • Drive integrated, creative marketing plans across CRM, social, paid media, PR and in-app that unlock incremental growth, with a high bar for execution.

Leading the team

  • Lead and develop a team of five, including two direct reports: set priorities and standards and develop their careers.
  • Build efficient ways of working, using automation and AI.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, ownership and executional excellence.

Key skills and experience

  • Significant senior marketing leadership experience (10+ years), ideally in retail, grocery, marketplace, eCommerce or tech.
  • Strong commercial and data fluency with a test-and-learn mindset: turn performance data into plans and defensible trade-offs, make sound investment decisions with incomplete data, and manage substantial budgets with measurable impact.
  • Experience building and executing multi-channel marketing strategies across acquisition, retention and brand.
  • Stakeholder management and influence, including joint business planning with large strategic partners, negotiating and building consensus across partners and internal teams.
  • Experience launching and scaling new propositions, categories or physical locations (e.g. stores).
  • Knowledge of the UK & Ireland grocery and retail landscape, and how shoppers behave in it.
  • Outstanding organisation and project management with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • People leadership: able to direct and develop a team with different levels of seniority.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
