title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape how data is modeled and governed at Airalo, transforming first- and third-party data into clean, trusted, well-documented datasets that power decisions across product, marketing, finance, and commercial teams, serving 30+ million users and growing. This role carries particular weight in our finance and revenue domain: you’ll steward the models finance relies on directly, including order-to-revenue flows and reconciliation against third-party systems such as our ERP, where precision and auditability matter as much as scalability.

Our analytics engineering function is still maturing, so you’ll have real ownership in establishing standards, defining our semantic layer, and shaping how data is structured as we scale globally, working closely with the rest of the data team to build a production-grade analytics platform on LightDash and beyond.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain data models using dbt within our cloud data warehouse, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and alignment with business logic

  • Build and maintain finance and revenue data models, including order-to-revenue flows, recognition logic, and reconciliation against source-of-truth financial systems, that finance and commercial teams can rely on for reporting and forecasting

  • Own the order-to-revenue pipeline: ensuring every order correctly and traceably resolves into recognized revenue, with clear handling of refunds, adjustments, currency conversion, and edge cases

  • Collaborate with other analytics engineers and data engineers to build and scale ELT workflows that ensure data freshness and reliability for mission-critical reporting

  • Partner with Finance and the ERP systems integrator to validate that data models and definitions carry over correctly from legacy systems into the new ERP/EPM platform

  • Implement robust testing, documentation, and monitoring practices, acting as a steward of data quality and governance across the platform, with particularly high attention to detail in domains where small errors compound (e.g., revenue, finance)

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to translate complex business questions into scalable, production-ready data artifacts

  • Partner with the data analysts and domain leadership to drive the rollout and adoption of self-service analytics, ensuring business users can trust and independently explore the data models you build

  • Contribute to the evolution of our modern data stack, bringing curiosity and pragmatic judgment to new tools and approaches

Must Haves:

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or equivalent work experience)

  • Hands-on experience building finance and/or revenue data models, ideally including order-to-revenue or billing-to-revenue pipelines, revenue recognition logic, or financial reconciliation (ERP, billing platforms or similar)

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or analytics roles with significant modeling responsibilities

  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with demonstrated experience designing robust, scalable dimensional models

  • Exceptional attention to detail, especially when working with numbers that feed financial reporting, reconciliation, or external disclosure

  • Significant hands-on experience with dbt (Core or Cloud) for managing transformation logic, testing, and documentation

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery) and data orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)

  • Experience working with modern BI platforms and semantic layers-LightDash experience is a strong plus

  • Track record of partnering with analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-structured data products

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to diverse audiences

  • Proactive self-starter who thrives on solving ambiguous problems and takes ownership from concept to production

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in marketplace, telecom, or travel/mobility businesses

  • Background in B2C product companies with high-volume event data

  • Experience building analytics engineering capabilities in low-maturity data environments

  • Previous experience at a scale-up that went through hypergrowth

  • Experience defining and governing company-wide KPIs and metric frameworks

  • Experience working alongside or within a finance function (e.g., supporting FP&A, revenue accounting, or audit processes) on data accuracy and traceability

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:

📍 UK: £74,800 – £112,200
📍 Spain: €77,600 – €116,400
📍 Germany: €76,000 - €114,000

Your Home Destination: 🛫 Local market rates and cost of living vary, so your specific range depends on where you’re based. Most people join in the first half of the band, which leaves you plenty of room to grow, and you’ll see exactly how that looks from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed what the role requires, we’re happy to talk about going higher. We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

title: Tax Manager
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

The Tax Manager is responsible for supporting a broad range of corporate tax functions, including tax provision, compliance, and planning. This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate financial reporting, maintaining compliance with federal, state, and international tax regulations, and supporting strategic tax initiatives. The position partners cross-functionally with finance, legal, and external advisors to drive efficient tax operations and informed decision-making

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and/or assist in the preparation of quarterly and annual tax provisions in accordance with ASC 740, including related financial reporting requirements
  • Prepare and review reconciliations of tax-related general ledger accounts
  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of U.S. federal, state, and international tax returns, as well as non-income and informational filings with external service providers
  • Support the preparation and review of tax return workpapers, ensuring alignment with financial reporting
  • Review state income tax apportionment calculations, state filings, and select pro forma federal returns prepared by external advisors
  • Calculate and prepare quarterly federal and state estimated tax payments
  • Maintain and manage the global tax compliance calendar in collaboration with third-party providers
  • Partner with external advisors on the annual R&D tax credit study, including data collection, analysis, and coordination with internal stakeholders

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related business discipline
  • 5–8 years of relevant tax experience (public accounting experience preferred or a mix of public and private)
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate tax principles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
  • Ability to research tax laws and apply sound judgment to reach well-reasoned conclusions

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA certification strongly preferred
  • Experience with ASC 740 tax provision processes and reporting
  • General understanding of international tax concepts
  • Demonstrated project and program management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects independently with minimal supervision
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Sales Engineer - Billing
description:
Elation is looking for an Sales Engineer - Billing to partner with our commercial selling teams as the billing and revenue cycle expert throughout the sales process. When prospects have detailed questions about claims workflows, denial management, or billing operations, you'll provide deep expertise, solve problems consultatively, and help close deals.

This is a pre-sales role focused on problem-solving and expertise, not just running demos. You'll conduct discovery with billing managers and practice administrators, translate complex workflows into clear solutions, and build the internal tools and processes that enable our team to sell with confidence.

This is also a builder role. You'll define what this function looks like by creating demo scripts, developing enablement programs, establishing office hours, and partnering with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape our approach. We're looking for someone entrepreneurial who thrives when building something new.

This role reports to the Director of Product Marketing with dotted-line reporting to the sales organization.

What You'll Do

Sales Support (60%)

  • Drive revenue by identifying and advancing qualified opportunities through expert billing consultation
  • Lead in-depth billing and revenue cycle conversations and demos with prospects when Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) need specialized expertise
  • Conduct discovery with billing managers, practice administrators, clinicians, and other stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and financial goals
  • Translate billing challenges into clear solutions that prospects can act on
  • Partner with AEs to move deals forward by handling objections, validating ROI, and building credibility
  • Run product demos, though the primary focus is problem-solving rather than demo delivery
  • Help prospects understand our AI-powered billing capabilities and the future of revenue cycle automation

Build the Function (40%)

  • Create the processes, tools, and enablement resources this new role needs
  • Develop billing training and education programs for Account Executives and Customer Success Managers (CSMs)
  • Run internal billing office hours to answer questions and build team confidence
  • Create and maintain demo scripts, talk tracks, competitive positioning, and sales collateral
  • Serve as a billing expert for Product and Customer Marketing
  • Partner with Product to translate product capabilities into clear value stories that resonate with prospects
  • Share customer insights to inform product roadmap and messaging

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

Deep billing and revenue cycle expertise

This is non-negotiable. You can independently lead detailed conversations with experienced billing managers and practice administrators. You understand the end-to-end revenue cycle from a practice perspective: scheduling, charge capture, claims submission, payment posting, denial management, A/R follow-up, and patient collections. You also understand the payer side: claims processing, denial reasons, eligibility verification, ERA/EOB, timely filing, and payer rules. You can explain complex workflows in clear, accessible language.

2-5+ years in a solutions engineering or pre-sales role supporting sales of billing or revenue cycle software

You've done this job before. You've successfully helped sales teams close deals and drive revenue by providing specialized expertise, conducting discovery, and solving complex problems. You're valued for your subject matter knowledge and ability to translate technical workflows into business solutions that impact the bottom line.

Experience selling to medical practices

You've worked with primary care, specialty practices, or small independent physician groups. You understand practice operations and what matters to practice owners, administrators, and billing managers. You know how to sell to multiple stakeholders and build consensus across a buying committee.

Builder and entrepreneurial mindset

You're comfortable defining a new role. You don't need a playbook handed to you. You can create processes, build programs, and establish best practices in a fast-paced environment where things are still taking shape.

Quick learner and problem solver

You're adaptable and can quickly identify what's needed, then figure out how to deliver it. You're open to feedback and can adjust your approach based on what the team needs. You're a collaborator who supports AEs rather than overshadowing them.

AI enthusiast

You're excited about AI in healthcare and can position AI-powered billing as an opportunity (not a threat). You're comfortable learning new technology and explaining it to skeptical audiences.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Previous sales or account executive experience before transitioning to solutions engineering
  • Deep payer-side expertise beyond working knowledge (claims processing, denial management, payer rules, coding)
  • Experience with value-based care or alternative payment models
  • Deep understanding of the outpatient billing and revenue cycle solutions in the healthcare market landscape

Who You Are

  • Expert: You're confident leading detailed billing conversations without needing to defer to others
  • Consultative: You lead with questions and discovery, not feature lists or prescriptive answers
  • Builder: You're entrepreneurial and comfortable creating structure where none exists
  • Collaborative: You're a team player who supports Account Executives and makes them better at their jobs
  • Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift
  • Coachable: You're open to feedback and can adjust your approach based on what the team needs
  • Customer-focused: You genuinely care about helping practices succeed

Salary Range: $100,000 - $140,000k/yr + variable

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Accountant to own core parts of our month-end and year-end close. You'll report to the Assistant Controller and join a focused team supporting two US manufacturing labs, a set of international entities and rising transaction volume. We are looking for a self-starter with an operational mindset who can navigate complex accounting transactions, and find solutions to new accounting scenarios as they arise.

Dandy runs on physical operations: labs, materials, equipment, shipping and people across several countries. Each of these flows into the general ledger. We want an accountant who understands how operations show up in the books and works with upstream teams to get the data right the first time.

Your main areas: prepaid and accrued expenses, operating expense coding, intercompany and consolidation, general ledger maintenance and close procedures. You'll partner with Operations, Procurement, People and FP&A to find process gaps and close them.

What you'll do

  • Own prepaid, accrued expense and opex schedules, including professional fees, software and contractor spend.

  • Prepare and post journal entries for the monthly, quarterly and annual close, with clear support for estimates, allocations and accruals.

  • Book intercompany entries and support consolidation across our US and international entities. Work with Tax on quarterly transfer pricing entries.

  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts and resolve differences before close.

  • Prepare flux analysis and explain monthly results to the Assistant Controller and FP&A.

  • Trace coding errors back to source systems such as payroll, purchasing and billing, and work with system owners to fix them upstream.

  • Document processes, accounting policies and controls to support our annual audit.

  • Prepare audit support schedules and respond to auditor requests.

  • Automate manual close steps in NetSuite and related systems.

What We're Looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.

  • 3+ years as a Senior Accountant, or 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

  • Experience in an operational business: manufacturing, distribution, healthcare services, logistics or multi-site operations.

  • Strong grasp of US GAAP, accruals, reconciliations and internal controls.

title: Demand Generation Manager, Auto
description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager, you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation.

You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web
  • Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas
  • Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance
  • Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs
  • Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach
  • Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence
  • Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review
  • Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization
  • Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau
  • Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results
  • Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality

What We Look For:

  • 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products.
  • Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool.
  • Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool).
  • Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment.
  • Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs.
  • Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization.

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary and stock option plan
  • 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company that’s transforming the IT industry. At Kaseya, you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, collaborate with a dynamic team, and develop your career in a high impact role.

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We’re hiring Platform Backend Engineers to build and operate the core services connecting workflow execution, identity, event routing, secrets management, and audit capabilities across Kaseya’s platform. This is a hands-on backend role focused on Go or Rust, event-driven systems, multi-tenant security, and production reliability. You’ll build foundational services used by engineering teams and AI-enabled workflows, with correctness, auditability, and operational clarity as core design requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and operate core platform services, including API gateways, event routing, identity integrations, secrets management, and audit infrastructure
  • Design event-driven systems that convert product events, alerts, and partner webhooks into durable workflow execution using Kafka and Temporal
  • Implement a pluggable key-management layer supporting cloud KMS providers, bring-your-own-key models, envelope encryption, and per-client cryptographic isolation
  • Build and enforce fine-grained capability grants for individual clients, workflows, operations, and service-to-service requests
  • Own GitOps-based deployment pipelines for versioned workflow definitions across isolated client environments
  • Develop onboarding automation for identity provisioning, compliance configuration, and client-specific key-management setup
  • Build secure connector services for third-party APIs, including scoped access, platform-managed credentials, request validation, and audit logging
  • Improve platform observability, reliability, failure recovery, security, and operational readiness while supporting production incident response

Required Qualifications

  • Experience building and operating production backend services using Go or Rust
  • Experience designing event-driven systems using Kafka or similar technologies, including retries, idempotency, replay, and at-least-once delivery
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, or fine-grained access controls
  • Experience implementing encryption or key-management solutions using cloud KMS platforms, envelope encryption, or key-hierarchy designs
  • Experience operating multi-tenant production systems using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and incident-response practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow orchestration platform
  • Experience integrating identity platforms such as Zitadel, Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or similar technologies
  • Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar, append-only, or audit-focused data store
  • Experience with GitOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code deployment practices
  • Experience integrating MSP, PSA, RMM, security, or Microsoft 365 platform APIs
  • Experience building software for regulated environments subject to SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, or similar requirements
  • Experience developing multi-cloud platform services across AWS, Azure, or GCP

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is CAD $180,000 – $250,000 / year.

An individual’s base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant. At Kaseya, certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role.

title: Payroll Tax Analyst
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Payroll Analyst supports accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery for Jamf's U.S. workforce while assisting with payroll processing for Jamf's international workforce. This role processes payroll and standard tax filings under established procedures, supports international payroll vendors on day-to-day matters, and escalates complex or novel tax and compliance issues to senior payroll staff.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Support U.S. payroll tax compliance by preparing standard federal, state, and local tax filings (Forms 941, 940, W-2, and W-3) for review, and assist with reconciling tax liabilities against the general ledger.
  • Process semimonthly U.S. payroll — wages, deductions, benefits, and garnishments — across multiple states in Workday, following established payroll procedures.
  • Research routine payroll tax notices and agency correspondence, escalating complex or novel issues to senior payroll or tax staff.
  • Support year-end processing, including W-2 preparation and reconciliation.
  • Support payroll processing for Jamf employees outside the U.S. by coordinating with in-country payroll providers on day-to-day pay accuracy and timeliness.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned international payroll vendors, flagging discrepancies for review before disbursement.
  • Process and audit garnishments, levies, and voluntary deductions in compliance with applicable law.
  • Coordinate with HR, Legal, and Finance on standard multi-state and multi-country payroll matters, escalating complex tax or compliance questions as needed.
  • Use AI-powered tools alongside other payroll technologies to support validation and reconciliation tasks, flagging anomalies for review.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of federal, state, and local payroll tax rules — FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and withholding (required)
  • Working knowledge of U.S. payroll processing experience (required)
  • Experience with a major payroll platform, such as Workday, ADP Workforce Now, ADP Streamline/Celergo, or UKG (required)
  • Exposure to international payroll processes, ideally partnering with in-country payroll providers or Employers of Record (EORs) (preferred)
  • Experience partnering with One Source Virtual (OSV) or similar payroll service providers to support U.S. payroll processing (preferred)
  • Proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables) for reconciliations and reporting (required)
  • Comfort using AI-powered tools to support payroll validation and reconciliation tasks (preferred)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree (preferred)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered (required)
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification, or an international payroll equivalent (preferred)

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Mental Well-being
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families

title: Senior Manager - Programmatic Strategy & Ad Operations (GCR)
description:
Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV). Powered by AI models trained on real campaign outcomes, Smadex delivers profitable growth at scale. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC) and one of the fastest-growing DSPs.



About the role


We are looking for a Senior Manager, Programmatic Strategy & Ad Operations — GCR to lead the Greater China Region (GCR) AdOps team and oversee a diverse portfolio of programmatic campaigns. This role reports directly to the Head of APAC Strategy and Operations.


This is a hands-on leadership and decision-making role. You will drive campaign performance, operational excellence and team development while partnering with Commercial and technical teams to support client growth.


We are looking for someone who takes ownership of problems and actively develops solutions—not someone who waits for direction. You will be expected to use data and sound judgment to make decisions, challenge assumptions constructively and follow through on outcomes.



What you’ll do



Lead strategy and decision-making


  • Own day-to-day AdOps strategy and operational decisions for the GCR team and portfolio.
  • Set priorities and allocate accounts and resources based on client importance, revenue impact, campaign complexity and team capacity.
  • Make informed decisions on optimization plans, testing priorities and workflows within agreed guardrails.
  • Manage and make recommendations on team structure, hiring needs, processes and broader business priorities.
  • Identify risks early and bring leadership a recommended path forward, not just the problem.



Own solutions and drive results


  • Proactively investigate performance, delivery and operational challenges before they escalate.
  • Develop practical, data-backed solutions, including clear actions, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.
  • Make progress independently where appropriate, while knowing when to involve specialists or leadership.
  • Follow solutions through implementation, measure their impact and adjust when needed.
  • Challenge existing approaches and propose better ways to improve performance, efficiency and service quality.



Drive campaign performance and operational excellence


  • Oversee the GCR portfolio, ensuring account strategies align with client KPIs such as ROAS, CPI, LTV and retention.
  • Ensure campaigns are launched, monitored, optimized and troubleshot to a consistently high standard.
  • Guide the team on pacing, bidding, inventory, attribution, measurement and performance analysis.
  • Lead high-stakes launches and complex troubleshooting, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for fraud, discrepancies, delivery risks and other urgent issues.
  • Maintain an agreed, manageable portfolio of hands-on accounts while protecting time to lead the team.



Lead and develop the team


  • Set clear expectations for quality, accountability, proactivity and communication.
  • Coach team members on campaign strategy, analytical thinking and independent decision-making.
  • Hold regular 1:1s, provide constructive feedback and support individual development plans.
  • Identify skills gaps and organize training, onboarding and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in hiring and recommend ways to strengthen team capacity and capabilities.
  • Build a culture where people raise concerns early, propose solutions and learn from results.



Partner across teams


  • Act as the AdOps leadership partner to GCR Commercial and Client Services, aligning on regional account priorities and client needs.
  • Align stakeholders on account priorities, client expectations, risks, timelines and next steps.
  • Translate complex analyses and technical issues into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Supply, Creative and other teams to resolve issues and improve performance.
  • Share recurring challenges and opportunities to help inform product and operational improvements.
  • Constructively push back when a request conflicts with data, client goals, capacity or agreed policies.



Build scalable practices


  • Develop and improve playbooks, QA processes, escalation paths and strategic frameworks.
  • Lead tests with clear hypotheses, success measures and documented learnings.
  • Share insights and best practices across the team and relevant regions.
  • Track portfolio and team health, highlighting performance, risks, capacity and support needed.
  • Stay current on programmatic advertising, mobile measurement, privacy and platform changes.



Decision-making scope


The Senior Manager is expected to decide and act independently on routine GCR team priorities, account allocation, campaign optimization and troubleshooting within agreed guardrails.


For decisions with broader implications—such as material client or financial risk, policy exceptions, hiring, compensation or organizational changes—the Senior Manager should provide a recommendation and align with their manager and relevant stakeholders. Specific approval thresholds should be agreed during onboarding.



What you bring


  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in programmatic advertising, DSP management or mobile performance marketing.
  • Experience leading, coaching or mentoring others while managing complex accounts and campaigns.
  • Strong knowledge of RTB, bidding, inventory management and performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of attribution, fraud prevention and privacy-compliant measurement.
  • Experience partnering with Commercial and technical teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn data into practical decisions.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to challenge ideas constructively.
  • Evidence of ownership: identifying a problem, developing a solution and following through on results.



What success looks like


  • The team delivers consistent campaign management and proactive support to Commercial.
  • Team members have clear priorities, manageable workloads and regular coaching.
  • Problems are identified early, with actionable solutions and clear ownership.
  • The Senior Manager makes well-reasoned decisions without relying on their manager for routine operations.
  • Cross-functional partners receive useful recommendations, and improvements are carried through to adoption.
  • The team grows in capability, accountability and confidence over time.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and aggressive performance-based incentive plans.
  • Fully remote working arrangement with flexible working hours.
  • Career pathing and continued education available.
  • Highly engaged leadership to support you in your position and career.
  • Friendly and inclusive working environment.
  • Opportunity for international travel.
  • Insurance coverage and support.
  • Short Summer Fridays.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Technosylva

Technosylva is the leading global provider of wildfire and extreme weather risk intelligence solutions, giving fire agencies, electric utilities and insurers decision-quality intelligence and the confidence to act. By combining advanced fire science with AI and supercomputing, Technosylva's platform processes billions of simulations a day, enabling customers to anticipate impacts, mitigate risk, and coordinate operational responses that safeguard their communities and teams.

Founded in 1997, Technosylva has offices in La Jolla, CA; León, Spain; and Calgary, Canada. Since 2022, backing from leading private equity growth investors has driven a period of significant growth and transformation. The company has scaled to more than 250 employees and now offers its products in more than 10 countries.

Role Overview

Technosylva’s products help our customers protect people and assets by making high quality and timely decisions. They use our software to apply world class fire, weather, and climate modeling and simulations to pressing operational and planning decisions.

As Senior Product Manager for Technosylva's Planning product, you will help drive the evolution of a platform used by major utilities and other safety-critical organizations to quantify wildfire risk at the asset level and prioritize life-saving mitigation and infrastructure hardening investments as we expand from wildfire into multi-hazard planning for flood, wind, and other extreme weather perils and help customers make risk-informed mitigation decisions that pass regulatory and insurance scrutiny. Our product helps customers answer the question: "Which investments will most effectively reduce my organization's risk from wildfires and extreme weather?"

You will take end-to-end ownership of major initiative areas within the Planning portfolio, partnering with the Planning Product Director to shape strategy and then driving your areas from discovery through delivery. Depending on your background and strengths, this could mean going deep on new analytical capabilities like mitigation prioritization and effectiveness modeling, or leading platform modernization efforts that underpin everything we build. Either way, you'll work across engineering, data science, design, sales, and customer success to ship capabilities that drive meaningful value for our customers.

Your work will directly support utilities and other organizations in protecting lives, property, and critical infrastructure — and will help Technosylva grow revenue within established markets and expand into new markets like insurance.

The people at Technosylva are passionate, expert, and welcoming. You’ll find this to be an environment where you can grow, while working to address some of the most urgent and challenging problems we face.

Responsibilities

  • Lead product discovery through customer interviews, data analysis, and market research to identify valuable, usable, and feasible solutions for our utility and agency customers
  • Create and maintain product artifacts while driving the process from conception through go-to-market, including beta testing and rollout strategies
  • Partner with engineering teams to define technical solutions and success metrics that align with business objectives
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap and vision based on customer needs, market opportunities, and business strategy
  • Build strong relationships with utility and other customers to deeply understand their workflows and pain points
  • Collaborate across sales and customer success teams to gather feedback and market requirements
  • Continuously refine product features based on customer feedback and emerging market needs
  • Assist with product pricing and packaging strategies

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of product management experience, including experience leading B2B/enterprise SaaS products
  • Track record of driving product discovery and validation, including leading research programs and developing systematic approaches to customer feedback
  • Expertise in SaaS metrics, unit economics, and business strategy
  • Experience managing large-scale enterprise deployments with utility companies or similar regulated industries
  • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to develop frameworks for complex decision-making
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams

Preferred Skills

  • Product development experience in ClimateTech, wildfire and/or utility software
  • Deep understanding of utility planning and regulatory frameworks
  • Experience with ML and advanced analytics
  • Experience using AI tools to manage product roadmaps, requirement writing and wireframing or UI/UX design

  • Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Phoenix PubSub

  • Oban (background jobs)
  • Tailwind CSS, LiveView JS hooks
  • Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry
  • Docker, Kubernetes, GCP

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • Design and build production Phoenix applications — REST APIs, LiveView UIs, and real-time features on PubSub and Channels.
  • Model and evolve data with Ecto and PostgreSQL, writing performant queries and safe, zero-downtime migrations.
  • Build fault-tolerant systems with OTP: supervision trees, GenServers, and distributed BEAM patterns where they earn their keep.

  • Experience with background job systems (Oban preferred) and event-driven architectures.
  • Solid testing discipline with ExUnit; comfortable with property-based and integration testing.
  • Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD best practices.
  • Security-minded engineering: OWASP fundamentals, auth patterns, secure handling of user data.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication, especially in remote/async environments, with a bias toward documenting architecture and decisions.

As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Data Engineer.

About the job

This position is needed to design, build, and optimize Twilio's next-generation unified data platforms and services to power strategic, data-driven business decisions.

As a senior technical leader on our Enterprise Data Engineering team, you will drive a massive, highly visible transformation to unify disparate data lakes into a single, high-performance platform. By combining classic dimensional modeling with cutting-edge AI, you will accelerate data delivery at an immense scale. This is your chance to solve complex architectural challenges, mentor rising talent, and directly influence Twilio’s strategic direction.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Architect and scale high-performance data platforms to unify acquired data lakes, improving delivery speed by leveraging AI-driven workflows.
  • Design robust ETL pipelines and data integration frameworks using Spark, dbt, and AWS to support rapidly growing enterprise data needs.
  • Establish rigorous data modeling standards (Dimensional, Medallion) and implement full-stack observability to ensure data trust.
  • Mentor peer engineers, promoting technical excellence and living our We > Me value through active collaboration with architects and product teams.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 8+ years of professional data engineering experience with progressive technical leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in languages, including scripting (e.g. Python, Scala, Java) and expert-level SQL.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing AWS cloud data infrastructure and scalable ETL pipelines (using Spark, dbt, or AWS Glue).
  • Expert knowledge of data modeling (Dimensional Modeling, Lakehouse/Medallion architectures).
  • Strong experience with distributed databases and query engines (such as Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, or Presto).
  • Proven track record of peer mentoring and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Desired:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines (Buildkite, ArgoCD).
  • Hands-on experience with ingestion systems (Kafka, Debezium, Meltano) and modern data formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Hudi).
  • Familiarity with relational/OLTP databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and OLAP databases (Clickhouse, Druid).
  • Experience leveraging Generative AI (LLMs, Langchain, Bedrock) to accelerate data delivery.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

description:
Senior Customer Service Lead & Trainer – Team Leadership & Customer Experience | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Customer Service Lead & Trainer to lead, coach, and develop a remote customer support team serving U.S.-based customers.

This is more than a traditional customer service position. You’ll take ownership of team performance, employee training, quality assurance, escalations, and overall customer experience.

You’ll ensure agents consistently deliver professional, efficient, and high-quality support across phone, email, chat, and other digital channels while using coaching and performance data to continuously improve the team.

If you’re an experienced customer service leader who knows how to develop people, improve performance, maintain accountability, and build strong service standards, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead and manage a distributed customer service team
  • Monitor agent productivity, quality, attendance, and KPI performance
  • Conduct regular one-on-one coaching and performance reviews
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve performance
  • Hold team members accountable to service and productivity standards
  • Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans
  • Track progress following coaching and corrective actions
  • Build a consistent, accountable, and high-performing remote team culture

Training & Onboarding

  • Own onboarding and training for new customer service hires
  • Develop and maintain:
    • Training materials
    • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
    • Call scripts
    • Customer service guidelines
    • Quality standards
  • Conduct structured training and coaching sessions
  • Review calls and customer interactions to identify training opportunities
  • Ensure new hires are fully prepared before independently handling customers
  • Continuously improve training programs based on recurring performance gaps

Quality Assurance & Coaching

  • Conduct regular call reviews and QA evaluations
  • Monitor adherence to scripts, processes, and customer experience standards
  • Identify recurring quality issues across the team
  • Coach agents on:
    • Communication
    • Professionalism
    • Problem-solving
    • Customer handling
    • Process adherence
  • Track improvement following coaching sessions
  • Maintain consistent QA standards across the customer support operation

Customer Experience & Escalations

  • Handle complex or escalated customer concerns professionally
  • Ensure customers receive consistent support across:
    • Phone
    • Email
    • Chat
    • Other digital communication channels
  • Maintain high standards for tone, responsiveness, and professionalism
  • Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements
  • Help resolve operational issues affecting customer satisfaction
  • Support agents in navigating difficult or sensitive customer situations

Customer Support Operations & Reporting

  • Track and report on:
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Response times
    • Resolution rates
    • Agent productivity
    • QA scores
    • Training performance
  • Maintain accurate documentation and operational records
  • Use customer service platforms, VOIP systems, ticketing tools, and reporting systems effectively
  • Identify trends and recurring performance issues through support data
  • Collaborate with other departments to resolve recurring customer or operational issues

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer service leadership, support supervision, or customer operations management
  • Proven experience managing remote and/or offshore customer service teams
  • Strong experience with employee coaching, training, and performance management
  • Experience conducting call reviews and quality assurance evaluations
  • Strong escalation management and customer problem-solving skills
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Experience working with:
    • Customer support platforms
    • VOIP systems
    • Ticketing systems
    • Digital communication tools
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to work U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers
  • Background in:
    • Facility Management
    • Energy
    • Tech-enabled services
  • Experience working in startup or high-growth environments
  • Experience scaling customer support teams
  • Strong knowledge of KPI-driven customer service operations
  • Experience developing:
    • SOPs
    • QA scorecards
    • Training programs
    • Coaching frameworks

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Know how to lead and develop people, not simply supervise them
  • Can give direct, constructive feedback professionally
  • Hold team members accountable while maintaining strong morale
  • Stay calm and solutions-focused during difficult escalations
  • Have high standards for customer communication and service quality
  • Understand how to use QA and performance data to improve agent performance
  • Are highly organized and consistent with follow-through
  • Can effectively manage a distributed team without constant oversight
  • Know how to turn recurring performance issues into structured coaching and training opportunities

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing team performance, attendance, customer service KPIs, and any outstanding escalations.

You’ll listen to calls, complete QA evaluations, coach agents on communication and performance, and conduct onboarding or training sessions where needed.

Throughout the day, you may handle escalated customer concerns, review response and resolution times, identify recurring service issues, update SOPs or scripts, and coordinate with internal teams on operational improvements.

You’ll also monitor agents requiring additional coaching and ensure improvement plans are producing measurable results.

In short: you ensure the customer service team is well-trained, accountable, consistent, and capable of delivering an excellent customer experience.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Quality assurance scores
  • Response and resolution times
  • Agent productivity
  • Training and onboarding effectiveness
  • Escalation resolution rates
  • Process and SOP adherence
  • Performance improvement following coaching
  • Overall team reliability and consistency

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over customer service quality and team performance
  • Direct influence on how agents are trained, coached, and developed
  • Opportunity to shape QA standards and training systems
  • Leadership responsibility within a growing remote support environment
  • Strong visibility across operations and customer experience
  • Career growth opportunities into:

    • Head of Customer Experience
    • Training & Quality Manager

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

title: Social Media and Community Manager
description:
OVERVIEW

Better Together works to end the root causes of poverty, dependency, divorce and child abuse by leveraging the power of the local church to provide struggling families with supportive relationships and meaningful work. Once properly supported, families can achieve independence, stay together and thrive.

The Social Media and Community Engagement Manager will lead Better Together’s social media strategy, driving innovative campaigns, compelling storytelling, and meaningful digital community engagement. This role proactively identifies opportunities to expand organizational visibility, strengthen brand affinity, position Better Together as a thought leader, and inspire audiences to take action. As the strategic owner of Better Together’s social media presence, this individual combines creative execution, data-driven decision-making, and relationship-building to advance organizational and regional priorities.

The ideal candidate is a savvy online communicator with a passion for leveraging social media to create impact and inspire action.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at Better Together are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five core values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of these questions, you may be a fit.

  1. Owners Mindset: You are invested in the outcomes of our mission.
  1. Are you a self-starter who is able to take initiative in order to complete a task?
  2. Do you often seek opportunities for professional growth?
  1. Choosing Gratitude: There are many things in life that can make us upset. Every day we have a choice to either be negative or give thanks.
  1. Do you often go out of your way to help others?
  2. Have you written a thank-you card in the last 30 days?
  3. Are you a positive person who is more focused on opportunities instead of obstacles?
  1. Love Others: We aim to love others like Christ loves us. Our hope is that our lives would be filled and overflowing with love, so that we can make a difference in this world.
  1. Do people often say you are a good listener?
  2. Do you make decisions based on what’s best for others over yourself?
  3. Do you often find yourself looking for ways to make others feel empowered, important and appreciated?
  1. Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.
  1. Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?
  2. Do you tend to be the one who initiates conversations with colleagues, rather than waiting for them to come to you?
  1. The Sky is the Limit: We have a big vision at Better Together. No one on our team is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.
  1. Do you often set yourself audacious goals?
  2. Do you wholeheartedly agree with our principles, which include that people’s lives are made better through work and that we can and will end the foster care crisis?

The vast majority of those who don’t get hired (or don’t last) at Better Together lack a fit with these values. Be prepared to have very candid conversations about them in our interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Social Media and Community Manager will have five primary roles, broken down into key responsibilities. They are:

Social Media Strategy and Campaign Management

  • Independently develop and execute proactive, month-over-month social media campaigns aligned with organizational priorities, audience engagement goals, and emerging opportunities.
  • Identify innovative opportunities to leverage social media for thought leadership, brand awareness, audience growth, and organizational influence.
  • Own the overarching social media strategy and editorial direction, balancing planned campaigns with timely, relevant content opportunities.
  • Stay current with social media trends, tools, and best practices to enhance performance, engagement, and brand presence.
  • Partner with the marketing team to align social media efforts with broader campaigns and organizational objectives.
  • Evaluate campaign performance and proactively recommend strategic adjustments to improve engagement, reach, and measurable organizational outcomes.

Content Creation and Distribution

  • Curate, create, and schedule engaging editorial content across platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), TikTok, Threads, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
  • Independently conceptualize and produce engaging, platform-specific content while collaborating with the Content and Creative team on larger campaign assets and storytelling initiatives.
  • Partner with the Video team on production, including concepting, scripting, and execution, to craft audience-specific video content.
  • Work closely with the Better Together team and broader community to create, edit, and distribute user-generated content (UGC), amplifying authentic stories and experiences.
  • Proactively identify compelling stories, trends, and timely content opportunities that can be translated into engaging social media campaigns.
  • Manage the social content calendar and coordinate the content pipeline with internal teams and stakeholders, balancing scheduled posts with real-time opportunities.

Digital Community Engagement and Real-Time Connection

  • Build an active online community of Better Together advocates. Identify and cultivate social media champions who share our stories and introduce others to our mission. Use those relationships to grow awareness, deepen engagement, and nurture warm leads for volunteering, events, and partnerships.
  • Proactively identify and cultivate relationships with relevant influencers, community partners, thought leaders, and digital stakeholders to expand Better Together’s reach and influence.
  • Identify opportunities to elevate Better Together’s voice in relevant social conversations, emerging trends, and issues aligned with its mission.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Communications to amplify public relations initiatives, organizational thought leadership, media coverage, and strategic messaging through social channels.
  • Develop creative digital engagement initiatives that foster meaningful connections, strengthen brand affinity, and encourage audiences to take action.
  • Lead proactive engagement strategies across social platforms, including relevant community groups, partner organizations, and influential voices.
  • Engage directly with our online community. Respond promptly to comments, messages, and mentions, tag relevant partners and supporters when appropriate, and actively participate in online groups and conversations aligned with our mission.

Analytics, Social Listening, and Regional Support

  • Establish and monitor key social media performance indicators, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations to marketing leadership.
  • Evaluate social media’s contribution to broader organizational goals, including volunteer acquisition, event participation, community partnerships, and audience growth.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize content, campaigns, and engagement strategies based on performance data and audience behavior.
  • Leverage social listening tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite) to gather insights and align content with audience preferences.
  • Collaborate with regional teams to promote local initiatives and customize content for specific needs and priorities.
  • Support regional EDs with tailored content and strategies to ensure alignment with overarching social media goals.
  • Seek opportunities to convert audiences into active participants, such as driving volunteer sign-ups, partnerships, or event attendance.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital marketing, community engagement, or related fields, with demonstrated ownership of successful social media campaigns and measurable results.
  • Proven ability to independently develop and execute strategic social media initiatives aligned with broader organizational objectives.
  • Experience cultivating influencer relationships, digital partnerships, and proactive community engagement opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of how social media supports public relations, thought leadership, brand positioning, and organizational visibility.
  • Strong understanding of content creation, creative strategies, and platform-specific best practices across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience in creating and editing social media shorts, reels, and video content tailored to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in leveraging social media tools such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or similar, and analytics platforms to track performance and optimize strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience translating social media performance data into actionable strategic recommendations.
